# Source: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
- **Artist / culture:** Georges Seurat (French, 1859–1891)
- **Date:** 1884–86, border added 1888–89
- **Style:** Pointillism
- **Classification:** oil on canvas
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 27992
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/27992
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/2d484387-2509-5e8e-2c43-22f9981972eb/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Chinese Landscape

## Extracted source palette

`#485848, #686868, #989868, #888888, #887868, #A89888, #A8A8A8, #8898A8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#252E25`
- `surface`: `#3E463E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#989868`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#8898A8`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E463E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#606760`
- `error`: `#989868`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `13.2:1`, surface `9.18:1`
- Variant contrast: `9.18:1`
- Control contrast: `6.54:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
